channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: SHS cross country teams cap historic 2025 season
item.description: Smithfield boys and girls cross country made the VHSL Class 4 State Meet for a second straight year.

item.title: Selma Dare Hundley Jones
item.description: Selma Dare Hundley Jones passed away on Monday, February 2, 2026

item.title: New SPSA AI waste program clears first test
item.description: A new AI trash-sorting system passed its first major test, diverting over half of waste from the Suffolk landfill. The Southeastern Public Service Authority has proposed contracting with Commonwealth Sortation to extend the life of the landfill.

item.title: Supplier Consistency: The Hidden Factor in Restaurant Success
item.description: Thriving restaurants share certain telltale signs: perfectly plated dishes, reliable packaging, napkins with actual absorbency, and leak-proof cups.

item.title: Editorial – Local regulation of land use under attack by state lawmakers
item.description: Virginia bills advancing in Richmond could strip localities like Isle of Wight and Smithfield of key land-use powers over housing, solar farms and energy storage projects.

item.title: IW Crime Line ups reward for info leading to arrest in 2023 Smithfield double homicide
item.description: The local Crime Line has increased the reward for tips in 2023 Smithfield double murder of Kyonne Edwards and A’Shoneya Williams; tipsters stay anonymous.

item.title: Some Surry homeowners say reassessments are inconsistent with neighbors
item.description: Surry County homeowners are questioning a 2025 “limited scope” property reassessment, citing sharp valuation swings between similar neighboring lots and homes.

item.title: Finance Department turnover delays IW 2024-25 audit to February
item.description: Turnover in Isle of Wight County's finance office has pushed completion of its 2024-25 audit past the Dec. 31 state deadline to February, with the school division's report now expected in March.

item.title: Riverside Smithfield Hospital improving ambulance travel time, data shows
item.description: Since Riverside Smithfield Hospital opened, Isle of Wight and Surry ambulances are reaching their destination faster, cutting turnaround times, fuel use and keeping more units close to home.

item.title: Town Council approves commercial development with drive-thrus by Smithfield Hampton Inn
item.description: Smithfield's Town Council has approved special use permits for a new retail complex with two drive-thru restaurants in front of the Hampton Inn off Benns Church Boulevard.
